Fixes from a careful look over 1.23.0.

- Putting away the box for a friend's name (on a phone or the web) no longer takes them off the list. A friend comes off with their ✕.
- A guest in a friend's village, changing one of the village's settings in the menu on a phone or the web, now asks the host as it should. It no longer changes their own village.
- The time of day in a friend's village, or a public square, is the village's (the host's, or the square keeper's), not each villager's own setting.
- The web page now gets the public squares' own settings from the village's relay, as the apps do.
- On a phone's browser, the joystick and buttons step out of the menu's way.
- At big menu sizes, the menu always fits across the screen.
- A drag let go over the friends widget isn't lost.
- The Santa Tracker on Christmas Eve morning: "he sets out tonight!".
- The relay (1.2.1): a connection's last will can't speak as the relay itself.
